lines.text: On the Mount of Sinai opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew privately ask when these things will happen.
The disciples will be beaten in synagogues and face governors and kings, and the Holy Spirit will speak.
Those in Judea must flee to the valleys at the abomination of desolation, and pray it is not winter.
For the elect's sake the Lord cut those days short, and Jesus told them everything in advance.
